name: @taprootcms/web
description: Reference consumer: a campus site reading content from a Taproot server over HTTP

scripts.//build: Node by default, because Taproot has no stake in where a site is hosted and the handbook says so. Set TAPROOT_TARGET=cloudflare to build for Workers instead — that is what makes this app's cache headers do anything, since Cloudflare caches no HTML by default and a Worker's own response is cached only if the Worker opts in (see wrangler.jsonc). Not wrapped in a script here because setting an environment variable inline is not portable across cmd and sh, and the deploy steps live in DEPLOYMENT.md.
